segments.text: Lesson 41
segments.translation: 第41课

segments.text: Training elephants
segments.translation: 驯象

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: At what point does the training of a captive wild elephant begin?
segments.translation: 被捕获的野象从何时开始训练？

segments.text: Two main techniques have been used for training elephants, which we may call respectively the tough and the gentle.
segments.translation: 驯象主要有两种方法，我们可以分别称之为强硬法和温和法。

segments.text: The former method simply consists of setting an elephant to work and beating him until he does what is expected of him.
segments.translation: 前一种方法就是让大象干活，打它直到它按要求行事。

segments.text: Apart from any moral considerations this is a stupid method of training,
segments.translation: 撇开道德因素不谈，这是一种愚蠢的训练方法，

segments.text: for it produces a resentful animal who at a later stage may well turn man-killer.
segments.translation: 因为它会产生一头心怀怨恨的大象，日后很可能成为杀人象。

segments.text: The gentle method requires more patience in the early stages,
segments.translation: 温和法在早期阶段需要更多耐心，

segments.text: but produce a cheerful good-tempered elephant who will give many years of loyal service.
segments.translation: 但能培养出性情愉快、脾气温和的大象，它将提供多年的忠诚服务。

segments.text: The first essential in elephant training is to assign to the animal a single mahout who will be entirely responsible for the job.
segments.translation: 驯象的首要任务是为大象指派一名专职驯象师，由他完全负责这项工作。

segments.text: Elephants like to have one master just as dogs do, and are capable of a considerable degree of personal affection.
segments.translation: 大象像狗一样喜欢有一个主人，并且能够产生相当程度的个人感情。

segments.text: There are even stories of half-trained elephant calves who have refused to feed and pined to death
segments.translation: 甚至有故事说半训练的小象拒绝进食，郁郁而终

segments.text: when by some unavoidable circumstance they have been deprived of their own trainer.
segments.translation: 当由于某些不可避免的情况失去了自己的驯象师时。

segments.text: Such extreme cases must probably be taken with a grain of salt,
segments.translation: 这些极端案例可能需要有所保留地看待，

words.word: take with a grain of salt

segments.text: but they do underline the general principle that the relationship between elephant and mahout is the key to successful training.
segments.translation: 但它们确实强调了一个普遍原则：大象与驯象师的关系是成功训练的关键。

segments.text: The most economical age to capture an elephant for training is between 15 and 20 years,
segments.translation: 捕获大象进行训练最经济的年龄在15到20岁之间，

segments.text: for it is then almost ready to undertake heavy work and can begin to earn its keep straight away.
segments.translation: 因为那时它已准备好承担繁重工作，可以立即开始赚取饲养成本。

segments.text: But animals of this age do not easily become subservient to man, and a very firm hand must be employed in the early stages.
segments.translation: 但这个年龄的动物不易顺从人类，早期阶段必须采取严厉手段。

segments.text: The captive elephant, still roped to a tree,
segments.translation: 被捕获的大象仍被绳索拴在树上，

segments.text: plunges and screams every time a man approaches, and for several days will probably refuse all food through anger and fear.
segments.translation: 每次有人靠近就猛冲尖叫，可能连续几天因愤怒和恐惧而拒绝进食。

segments.text: Sometimes a tame elephant is tethered nearby to give the wild one confidence,
segments.translation: 有时会在附近拴一头驯服的大象给野象壮胆，

segments.text: and in most cases the captive gradually quietens down and begins to accept its food.
segments.translation: 多数情况下被捕获的大象会逐渐平静下来并开始进食。

segments.text: The next stage is to get the elephant to the training establishment,
segments.translation: 下一阶段是将大象送到训练机构，

segments.text: a ticklish business which is achieved with the aid of two tame elephants roped to the captive on either side.
segments.translation: 这是一项棘手的工作，需要两头驯服的大象拴在被捕获大象两侧来完成。

segments.text: When several elephants are being trained at one time,
segments.translation: 当同时训练几头大象时，

segments.text: it is customary for the new arrival to be placed between the stalls of two captives whose training is already well advanced.
segments.translation: 通常将新来者安置在两头训练进展顺利的大象隔间之间。

segments.text: It is then left completely undisturbed with plenty of food and water
segments.translation: 然后让它完全不受打扰，提供充足的食物和水

segments.text: so that it can absorb the atmosphere of its new home and see that nothing particularly alarming is happening to its companions.
segments.translation: 以便它能感受新家的氛围，看到同伴们没有发生什么特别令人惊慌的事。

segments.text: When it is eating normally, its own training begins.
segments.translation: 当它正常进食时，它自己的训练就开始了。

segments.text: The trainer stands in front of the elephant holding a long stick with a sharp metal point.
segments.translation: 驯兽师站在大象面前，手持一根带有尖锐金属头的长棍。

segments.text: Two assistants, mounted on tame elephants, control the captive from either side,
segments.translation: 两名助手骑在驯服的大象上，从两侧控制被捕获的大象，

segments.text: while others rub their hands over his skin to the accompaniment of a monotonous and soothing chant.
segments.translation: 其他人则用手抚摸它的皮肤，伴随着单调而舒缓的吟唱。

segments.text: This is supposed to induce pleasurable sensations in the elephant,
segments.translation: 这据说能让大象产生愉悦的感觉，

segments.text: and its effects are reinforced by the use of endearing epithets,
segments.translation: 并用亲昵的称呼来强化效果，

segments.text: such as 'ho! my son', or 'ho! my father', or 'my mother', according to the age and sex of the captive.
segments.translation: 如'嗬！我的儿子'、'嗬！我的父亲'或'我的母亲'，根据被捕获大象的年龄和性别而定。

segments.text: The elephant is not immediately susceptible to such blandishments, however, and usually lashes fiercely with its trunk in all directions.
segments.translation: 然而大象不会立刻被这些甜言蜜语打动，通常会用鼻子猛烈地朝四面八方甩动。

segments.text: These movements are controlled by the trainer with the metal-pointed stick,
segments.translation: 这些动作由驯兽师用金属尖棍控制，

segments.text: and the trunk eventually becomes so sore that the elephant curls it up and seldom afterwards uses it for offensive purposes.
segments.translation: 象鼻最终变得如此疼痛，以至于大象将它卷起来，之后很少再用于攻击目的。
